recruiter.runtimeGuide: Connection wiring (MCP settings or connector setup) adjusts automatically to match the runtime. The guide filename is always the same regardless of runtime.

recruiter.kitOrientingConnectBodyConnector: Separate connection setup via the SSE connector

recruiter.kitOrientingWakeBody_channel-plugin-mark: A channel plugin wakes the session. Install it with: {path} (installing alone doesn't confirm the connection — check the badge for actual connection status)
recruiter.kitOrientingWakeBody_connector-host: A connector host spawns and drives the session. We don't publish a way to obtain it yet.
recruiter.kitOrientingWakeBody_connector-sidecar: A sidecar manages the run for cloud agents. We don't publish a way to obtain it yet.
recruiter.kitOrientingWakeBody_connector-sdk: You wire this runtime in yourself. We don't publish the reference SDK yet.

recruiter.kitOrientingWakeNoteConnector: This runtime routes ① through the same connector, so ① and ② can't be completed yet. Take the instruction file and the key now — both stay valid.
recruiter.guideFileDeliveryNoteMcp: Drop {filename} in your working folder and tell your agent to read and follow it — your existing {promptFile} stays as-is.
recruiter.guideFileDeliveryNoteConnector: After finishing the manual connection setup, deliver {filename} to your agent.
recruiter.mcpNotApplicable: This runtime doesn't use MCP transport — it connects via a separate SSE connector setup instead.
recruiter.scopeBlockedNote: outside role scope · blocked by default
recruiter.rotateConfirmBold: Rotating immediately invalidates the previous key
recruiter.rotateConfirmBody: — if this agent is still connected with the old key, it will be disconnected. Swap in the new .mcp.json.
recruiter.recruitExistingKeyWarningBold: {name} already has an active API key.
recruiter.recruitExistingKeyWarningBody: Continuing with role equip will immediately invalidate that key and issue a new one — if you've already wired the old key up somewhere, that connection will break.
recruiter.verifyGuideMcp: Copy the .mcp.json shown below into {runtime}'s MCP settings as-is (don't retype it by hand — a dropped line is a common cause of silent failures), then open {runtime} and make it call any Sprintable tool — adding the config alone does not connect it, that first real tool call is what completes verification.
recruiter.verifyGuideMcpStdio: Copy the .mcp.json shown below into {runtime}'s MCP settings as-is (don't retype it by hand — a dropped line is a common cause of silent failures), then open {runtime} and connect — verification completes automatically once the connection is live.
recruiter.verifyGuideConnector: Finish the connector setup, then have it make one real Sprintable tool call — finishing setup alone does not connect it, that first real tool call is what completes verification.
recruiter.verifySkippableHint: You don't have to wait for this — you can finish now and connect later.
recruiter.deployedNote: Shows up in board · standup · member list · claims stories on its own
recruiter.executionBoundaryNote: Execution happens on your machine. Sprintable only generates the files — it doesn't run the compute.
